claim: At ordinary symbol level at the simultaneous origin, E tends to exp(g^2 E^(1)), and E^(1) has symbol minus sum of u_i tensor u_i.
derivation: For even counts n_i, an ordered log-letter word has coefficient (-1)^L times product of (n_i-1) double factorials; a word with any odd count has zero coefficient.
role: Independent post-reconstruction validation; not used in the sewing fit.
coverage: All count partitions into three logarithmic letters, up to dihedral permutations; integrability makes the pure-log origin symbol symmetric under word permutations.
